pages.text: A gentle chime sounds as Ava the smart helper wakes up. She is ready to listen carefully.
When someone speaks, Ava listens. Voices travel as sound waves into tiny microphones.
Inside, the sounds change into data. Data helps computers understand words and meaning.
Ava can answer questions, play music, or set reminders when asked politely.
Sometimes Ava talks back. Speakers turn information into clear sounds people can hear.
The internet helps Ava find answers quickly. Without a connection, she knows less.
Smart helpers can control lights or timers. They help when hands are busy.
People stay in charge. Grown-ups choose settings and decide what Ava can do.
Electric power keeps Ava ready. When turned off, listening stops completely.
As the house grows quiet, Ava rests. Tomorrow, she will listen and help again.
